name: James Barnes
original_name: ジェイムズ・バーンズ
source:
Lieutenant Colonel in the U.S. Army stationed in Japan.
A stoic soldier that is strict with himself and others. He's fluent in Japanese. 
Because of an old wound on his left leg he walks with a cane and has stepped back from active duty to act as a guide for the younger generation.
Sometimes he shows a kind smile to the protagonist.
